newsitem.title: USA: Caraco gets FDA generic drug approval.
newsitem.headline: Caraco gets FDA generic drug approval.

text.p: Caraco Pharmaceutical Laboratories Ltd said Tuesday it had received approval from the Food and Drug Administration to make paromomycin sulfate capsules, or USP.
Caraco said it is the first generic approval for USP, the generic version of Parke Davis Ltd's Humatin capsules.
Caraco said the approval is the second for the abbreviated new drug approvals it has filed with the FDA. It said it expects a third product approval later this year.
The firm makes generic drugs for the over-the-counter market.
